note: TCEQ plain-language summary for air permit application 182126 (Crusoe, Longhorn Data Center, Abilene)
excerpt:
Plain Language Summary for New Source Review (NSR)
Initial Application for Air New Source Review Permit
Number 182126, GHGPSDTX263 and PSDTX1688
The following summary is provided for this pending air permit application being reviewed by
the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality as required by 30 Texas Administrative
Code Chapter 39. The information provided in this summary may change during the
technical review of the application and are not federal enforceable representations of the
permit application. Crusoe Energy Systems LLC (CN606257079) has submitted an
application for an initial permit 182126, GHGPSDTX263, and PSDTX1688. The Longhorn
Data Center (RN112029061) will generate electricity at 32.50792, -99.77722, Abilene,
Taylor County. This permit will authorize additional power generation equipment for onsite
consumption in data center buildings. Crusoe Energy Systems LLC has listed in the
application the pollutants and amounts that will be emitted for the facility. Below is the
total amount for each pollutant that is proposed to be emitted each year for all the
facilities.

The new equipment will be controlled by selective catalytic reduction and oxidation
catalysts to reduce NOx, CO, VOCs, and HAPs.
